import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a countplot for transaction type by is_fraud
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=df)
plt.title('Transaction Type by Fraud Status')
